title: Interpolation Conditions for Instant Data Consistency with Port-Hamiltonian Structure
summary: We develop a data-driven framework for nonlinear port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems based on interpolation conditions to characterize consistency between observed data and structured dynamical models. Specifically, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of a pH system with a smooth (convex) Hamiltonian instantly consistent with a given dataset, without requiring explicit parametrization.
